title: Successive bribery sets
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. For every natural number $t$, the bribery set at stage $t+1$ is obtained from the stage-$t$ set by adjoining a coordinate of maximum influence for the function bribed on that set to output $1$ if the mean of that bribed function is less than $99/100$; otherwise, the set is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
